source_review: get_audio_feature calls planned_audio_feature first; plans reject unsupported/failed graph buckets before planned convolution, and return through existing general route on rejection. Routing, one-fallback and BF16 parity tests retained.
scope_limit: Actual encoder graph initialization observed. Per-request host-plan hit/replay counts were not instrumented in timed runs and are not inferred from capture counts. No runtime modifications or reruns.

default_pre_LM_route.service_encode_batch: Calls model.get_audio_feature(items) directly, before the language-model multimodal embedding routine; completes with PRECOMPUTED_EMBEDDING items.
default_pre_LM_route.model_path: get_audio_feature tries planned_audio_feature before the general eager/graph route.
default_pre_LM_route.separate_general_mm_route: Installed SGLang moves audio features to device in its general multimodal embedding route. The default pre-LM service bypasses that transfer. This does not prove per-request host-plan hit counts.
